relevance_note: Case report of one man with genetically confirmed LAD-I: 'LAD-1 was genetically confirmed in the patient in 2008 by one of us (DR) who found 2 heterozygous mutations in the ITGB2 gene'.
method_note: Single case report plus parents and sister, all described in relation to the patient (granulocyte integrin testing; variant carriage). Built with a short Python script from my own reading; every span asserted verbatim against the Markdown. Table I has relatives as columns (Patient, Sister, Mother, Father, Ref.); only the CD18 row of the Patient column is quoted. The Markdown prints '>' and '<' as '>'/'<'; spans keep the entity, values decode it (c.130A>C). The splice variant is printed only as 'intron 14+1delG' (no c. notation), so cdna_hgvs_as_stated is null. Variant type for c.130A>C recorded as missense from the authors' description 'point mutation' that is 'predicted to replace threonine-44 in CD18 by proline'; the word 'missense' is not used. Inheritance from 'from the mother'/'from the father'; relatives' zygosity not stated, so not reported. The sister was tested negative for both variants ('His healthy sister did not carry any of these mutations') and has no variant rows. Possible internal tensions, all recorded as separate rows: leukocytosis 33 x 10^9/l at age 3 vs 'no basal leukocytosis (except during corticosteroid therapy)' (checklist kept observed: an episode was reported); early 'reduced chemotaxis' and reduced NBT vs later 'normal migration and phagocytosis' and 'normal respiratory burst' (different time points). 'paradontitis' absence does not exclude the broader 'periodontitis or gingivitis' item (left not reported). 'absence of pus formation' marked excluded because the paper reports ulcerations 'with pain, pus'. 'no systemic infections' covers only the treatment period since 2007 and excludes no checklist item. Pertussis not mapped to lower respiratory tract infection. Treatment summary lists the main regimens within the 5-span limit; also reported: penicillin, betamethasone, etanercept, azathioprine, isotretinoin, topical tacrolimus, infliximab (2.5-5 mg/kg), flucloxacillin, IvIG. Age at diagnosis not stated (only years 2008 and 2002 'at the age of 15'); not computed. Patient's country of origin not stated (affiliations only).
